question: Qual a razão entre o valor de frete e o preço das mercadorias vendidas agrupada pelas top 3 categorias de produtos?
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p.category_name_pt, 
    ROUND(SUM(oi.freight_value) / NULLIF(SUM(oi.price), 0), 4) AS freight_to_price_ratio, 
    ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS total_price 
FROM marts.fct_order_items oi 
JOIN marts.dim_products p 
    ON oi.product_id = p.product_id 
WHERE oi.is_delivered = TRUE 
GROUP BY p.category_name_pt 
HAVING SUM(oi.price) > 0 
ORDER BY total_price DESC 
LIMIT 3;
reasoning: Deterministic resolution for L4 (correct semantic execution)
